name: Mikhail Gorobets
biography: is a security researcher in the Advanced Threat Research team. His area of expertise includes hardware security, virtualization technologies, reverse engineering, and vulnerability analysis. Previously, he led a team of security researchers working on Intel Virtualization Technology (VTx) and Intel Atom core security evaluation. Mikhail holds a MS in computing machines, systems, and networks from the Moscow Institute of Electronics and Mathematics.
